raw_text:
Here’s the full, integrated 12-week muscle-gain plan for your 26-year-old vegan client, including training (with added cardio and Phase 3 intensity push), nutrition to hit 150 g/day protein from plants, recovery, and a weekly cheat meal structure.

Plan overview
- Goal: Build muscle and strength with progressive overload, smart intensity, and adequate recovery.
- Duration: 12 weeks in 3 phases.
- Equipment: Full gym.
- Split: Weeks 1–8 = 4 days/week (Upper/Lower/Upper/Lower). Weeks 9–12 = 5 days/week (Push/Pull/Lower/Upper/Glutes+Hams).
- Cardio: 60–150 min/week Zone 2 with limited tempo/HIIT, placed to minimize interference.
- Protein: 150 g/day plant-only; 4–5 feedings of 25–40 g each.
- Extras: 1 weekly cheat meal with guardrails.

Warm-up and prep (every session)
- 3–5 min light cardio.
- Dynamic mobility: T-spine openers + band pull-aparts (upper); leg swings, hip airplanes, ankle rocks (lower).
- Ramp-up sets for first 1–2 compounds (40–60–75% of work weight).

Phase 1: Weeks 1–4 (Foundation and skill; 4 days/week)
Structure: ULUL; 60–80 min sessions. Progression: Add 2.5–5 lb weekly to compounds if reps met; add 1 rep to accessories before load. Target 1–3 RIR on compounds; 1–2 RIR accessories.

Week 1 template (repeat and progress Weeks 2–4)
Upper A
- Barbell bench press 4x6–8
- One-arm DB row 4x8–10/side
- Seated DB shoulder press 3x8–10
- Lat pulldown 3x10–12
- Incline DB or cable fly 2x12–15
- Cable lateral raise 3x12–15
- Rope triceps pressdown 3x10–12
Lower A
- Back squat 4x6–8
- Romanian deadlift 4x8–10
- Walking DB lunges 3x10–12/side
- Leg curl 3x10–12
- Leg press calf raise 4x10–12
Upper B
- Weighted or assisted pull-up 4x5–8
- DB incline bench press 4x8–10
- Chest-supported row 3x8–10
- Arnold press 3x10–12
- Face pulls 3x12–15
- Cable curls 3x10–12
- Overhead cable triceps extension 3x10–12
Lower B
- Deadlift (conventional or sumo) 3x4–6 (heavier)
- Front squat or hack squat 3x6–8
- Bulgarian split squats 3x8–10/side
- Barbell hip thrust 4x8–10
- Seated calf raise 4x12–15

Week-by-week notes
- Week 2: Same lifts; add small load if RIR targets held, or +1 rep on accessories.
- Week 3: Add 1 set to one lagging muscle per session (e.g., chest, glutes).
- Week 4: Keep sets; final accessory set near failure (0–1 RIR). One optional isolation intensity (single drop or myo-reps).

Cardio Weeks 1–4 (60–90 min/week)
- Post Upper A and Upper B: 10–12 min Zone 2.
- Rest/active day: 25–30 min Zone 2.
- Optional: 10–20 min easy walking on one weekend day.
- Keep cardio away from heavy lower days when possible.

Phase 2: Weeks 5–8 (Volume/intensity progression; unilateral focus)
Structure: ULUL; top-set + back-off on primary compounds. Weekly sets per muscle up ~10–15% vs Phase 1.

Week 5 template (progress Weeks 6–8)
Upper A
- Bench: 1 top set 6–8 (1–2 RIR), 2 back-offs -8–10% x8–10
- One-arm chest-supported row 4x8–10/side
- Seated DB shoulder press 4x6–8
- Wide pulldown 3x8–10
- Cable fly or pec deck 3x10–12
- Lateral raise (machine/cable) 4x12–15
- Rope pressdown 3x10–12 + 1 drop
Lower A
- Back squat: 1 top set 5–6, 3x6–8 at -10%
- RDL 4x6–8 (2 RIR)
- DB step-ups 3x8–10/side
- Leg curl 4x8–10
- Standing calf raise 4x8–10 (2–3 s pause)
Upper B
- Weighted pull-up: 1 top set 5–6, 2–3x6–8 assisted as needed
- Incline DB bench 4x6–8
- Chest-supported row (neutral) 4x8–10
- Machine shoulder press 3x8–10
- Face pulls 3x12–15
- EZ-bar curl 3x8–10 + 1 back-off AMRAP (2 RIR)
Lower B
- Deadlift: 1 top set 3–5 (1–2 RIR), 2x4–5 at -10–12%
- Front squat or hack squat 4x6–8
- Hip thrust 4x6–8 (2 s squeeze)
- Bulgarian split squat 3x8–10/side
- Seated calf raise 4x12–15

Week-by-week notes
- Week 6: +2.5–5 lb on top sets if top reps achieved; +1 rep on back-offs. Optionally add 1 set to side delts/hamstrings if recovery is strong.
- Week 7: Maintain top-set loads; push back-offs to top of ranges. Add cable kickbacks 3x12–15 (Lower B) and reverse pec deck 3x12–15 (Upper B).
- Week 8: Small overload to compounds; final accessory set per muscle near failure.

Cardio Weeks 5–8 (80–120 min/week)
- Upper days: 12–15 min Zone 2 post-lift; on one upper day include 2 x 3-min tempo pickups (RPE 7–8) with 2-min easy.
- Rest day: 30–35 min Zone 2.
- Optional easy 10–15 min spin after Lower B for recovery.
- Keep tempo work ≥24 h from lower-body sessions.

Phase 3: Weeks 9–12 (Specialization + intensity push; 5 days/week)
Structure: Push/Pull/Lower-Quads/Upper-Mixed/Glutes+Hams. Top set + 2 back-offs on compounds. Elevated intensity methods on isolations with recovery guardrails.

Week 9
Push
- Bench: 1 top set 5–6 (1–2 RIR), 2x6–8 back-offs
- DB incline press 3x8–10
- Machine shoulder press 3x8–10
- Cable fly 3x12–15
- Lateral raises 4x12–15
- Overhead cable triceps 3x10–12
Pull
- Weighted pull-up: 1 top set 4–6, 2x6–8 back-offs
- Chest-supported row 4x8–10
- Wide pulldown 3x10–12
- Reverse pec deck 3x12–15
- Cable curls 3x10–12
- Incline DB curls 2x12–15
Lower (Quads)
- High-bar squat: 1 top set 4–6, 2–3x6–8 back-offs
- Hack squat or leg press 3x8–10
- Walking lunges 3x10–12/side
- Leg extension 3x12–15 (2 s squeeze)
- Standing calf raise 4x10–12
Upper (Mixed)
- Overhead press: 1 top set 4–6, 2x6–8 back-offs
- Flat DB press 3x8–10
- One-arm cable row 3x10–12/side
- Face pulls 3x12–15
- Hammer curls 3x10–12
- Rope pressdowns 3x10–12
Glutes/Hams
- Deadlift (sumo or conventional): 1 top set 3–5, 2x4–6 back-offs
- Hip thrust 3x8–10 (2 s peak)
- Leg curl 4x8–10
- Cable kickbacks 3x12–15
- Lateral raise mechanical drop set x2 rounds (optional finisher)
- Preacher curl 2x12–15; DB skull crushers 2x12–15

Week 10 (intensity add-ons)
- Compounds: Add 2.5–5 lb (upper) and 5–10 lb (lower) if Week 9 hit top reps at 1–2 RIR. Back-offs: +1 rep/set.
- Isolations: 1 intensity technique per session:
  - Rest-pause on one isolation (e.g., rope pressdown, leg curl).
  - Or myo-reps on rear delts/laterals.
- Keep compounds at 0–1 RIR top sets; no failure.

Week 11 (variation switch + top-set push)
- Swap: Close-grip bench on Push; front squat on Lower; RDL on Glutes/Hams; single-arm DB row on Pull.
- Top sets: 0–1 RIR aiming for a small rep PR vs Week 9 equivalents.
- Back-offs: Same load; slightly shorter rest or +1 rep.
- Optional finishers: One drop set on delts or arms; constant-tension set on hack squat/hip thrust.

Week 12 (peak effort)
- Compounds: Match Week 11 loads and push for small rep PRs at same RIR; back-offs to top of ranges at 0–1 RIR. Stop at technical failure.
- Isolations: One to true failure per session on a safe machine/cable; optional mechanical drop set for delts/arms.

Cardio Weeks 9–12 (90–150 min/week; keep legs fresh)
- Push: 12–15 min Zone 2 post-lift.
- Pull: 20–25 min Zone 2.
- Lower (Quads): No post-lift cardio; optional 10–15 min recovery walk later.
- Upper (Mixed): 12–15 min Zone 2 with 4 x 60-sec tempo pickups (RPE 7–8), 90-sec easy.
- Glutes/Hams: No post-lift cardio; optional 10–15 min very easy spin later.
- One weekend session: 30–40 min Zone 2 OR micro-dose HIIT (6–8 x 20 sec hard/100 sec easy on bike/rower) only if recovery is excellent and ≥48 h from heavy lower day.
- Weeks 11–12: If intensity feels high, reduce cardio volume by ~20%.

Cheat meal (weekly, single meal)
- Timing: Best after an upper or Push/Upper-Mixed day; avoid the evening before heavy lower days.
- Structure: 30–50 g vegan protein + 100–180 g carbs + 20–35 g fat. Hydrate and salt.
- Examples: Plant-based burger + baked fries; vegan pizza + tofu/tempeh or a shake; sushi rolls + edamame.
- Calorie fit: Trim earlier fats by 30–40 g that day; still hit 150 g protein total.

Nutrition (plant-only; 150 g protein/day)
- Calories: Start ~+200–300 kcal over maintenance. If weight gain <0.25–0.5% BW/week after 2 weeks, add 100–150 kcal/day (carbs first).
- Protein: 150 g/day across 4–5 meals. Aim for 25–40 g per meal with ~2–3 g leucine.
- Carbs: 3–5 g/kg/day; 60–90 g around training (pre + post). Use lower-fiber carbs post-evening lifts if digestion/sleep are issues.
- Fats: 0.6–0.8 g/kg/day; distribute mostly away from peri-workout window.

Protein sources and supplements
- Protein powders: Pea + rice blend or soy isolate, 25–35 g post-workout or as needed. Choose third-party tested.
- Whole-food anchors: Tofu, tempeh, soy yogurt, seitan, edamame, lentils, chickpeas, beans, quinoa, buckwheat.
- Complements and health:
  - Creatine monohydrate: 3–5 g/day.
  - Algae omega-3 (EPA+DHA): 1–2 g/day.
  - Vitamin B12: ~1,000 mcg/week (or per RD).
  - Vitamin D3 (vegan): 1,000–2,000 IU/day, adjust to labs.
  - Iron/iodine: Monitor intake/labs; supplement only if needed.

Post-workout meal ideas (25–45 g protein; 60–100 g carbs)
- Tempeh stir-fry with 1.5–2 cups rice.
- Tofu scramble burrito with black beans.
- Lentil bolognese over pasta + nutritional yeast.
- Sushi bowl with baked tofu + edamame.
- Shake: 1–1.5 scoops vegan protein + oats, banana, soy milk.

High-protein breakfasts (30–45 g protein)
- Tofu scramble + toast + nooch.
- Protein oats with soy milk + 1–1.5 scoops vegan protein.

  - Day 4 (Upper B): 10–12 min Zone 2 post-lift.
  - Day 5 (Lower B): Off from cardio post-lift; optional 10–15 min easy spin purely for flush.

Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8)
- Target: 80–120 min/week Zone 2; add one short tempo segment weekly
- Suggested schedule:
  - Day 1 (Upper A): 12–15 min Zone 2 post-lift.
  - Day 2 (Lower A): Off post-lift; 20–25 min Zone 2 later that day or next morning.
  - Day 3 (Rest/Active): 30–35 min Zone 2.
  - Day 4 (Upper B): 12–15 min Zone 2 post-lift including 2 x 3-min tempo pickups (RPE 7–8) with 2-min easy between.
  - Day 5 (Lower B): Optional 10–15 min very easy spin/walk.

- Notes: Keep tempo work away from lower sessions by at least 24 hours.

Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12)

  - Day 1 (Push): 12–15 min Zone 2 post-lift.

  - Day 4 (Upper—Mixed): 12–15 min Zone 2 post-lift including 4 x 60-sec tempo pickups (RPE 7–8), 90-sec easy between.

- If scale gain drops below 0.25% bodyweight/week for 2 consecutive weeks, add 100–150 kcal/day (primarily carbs).

Great—here’s how to safely push intensity in Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12) while prioritizing hypertrophy, performance, and recovery. We’ll keep the 5-day split but add structured top-set progression, advanced hypertrophy techniques, and tighter effort targets. Use these layers only if reps and form remain solid.

Global rules for Phase 3 intensity
- Effort targets: Compounds 0–2 RIR, isolations 0–1 RIR. Final set of each isolation can hit 0 RIR with pristine form.
- Top-set model: 1 heavy top set in the lower rep range, then 2 back-off sets at -8–12% load for higher reps and shorter rest.
- Rest times: Compounds 2–3 min; accessories 60–90 sec; isolations 45–75 sec. Use a timer to increase density.
- Tempo: Control eccentrics 2–3 sec; purposeful stretch on lengthened moves (RDLs, incline DB press, lateral raises).
- Failure policy: Only on isolation/accessories; stop compounds at technical failure—no grinding that breaks form.
- Micro-progression: If you hit top reps at target RIR, add load next week. If you miss, keep load and add a rep on back-offs or reduce rest slightly.

Week-by-week intensity plan

Week 9 (Baseline intensity + density primer)
- Compounds: 1 top set (RIR 1–2) + 2 back-offs (RIR 1–2). Start with current Week 8 bests.
- Accessories: Last set to 0–1 RIR.
- Density: Cap accessories to 60–75 sec rest; aim to maintain reps.
- Optional techniques (1 per session, isolation only):
  - Myo-reps: 1 activation set to 1 RIR, then 3–5 mini-sets of 3–5 reps with 5 deep breaths between on lateral raises, curls, or leg extensions.

Week 10 (Overload + partial failure on isolations)
- Add 2.5–5 lb (1–2 kg) to upper-body compounds and 5–10 lb (2–5 kg) to lower compounds if Week 9 hit top reps with 1–2 RIR.
- Back-offs: Add 1 rep to each back-off set versus Week 9.
- Add 1 intensity technique per session (pick one):
  - Rest-pause (isolation): Take a set to 0–1 RIR, rest 20–25 sec, then continue to 2–4 more reps; e.g., rope pressdowns, leg curls.
  - Lengthened partials: After full-ROM failure, do 3–5 partials in the strongest range on lateral raises, curls, leg extensions.

Week 11 (Variant switch + top-set push)
- Swap key compounds as previously planned (e.g., close-grip bench, front squat, RDL) and drive intensity:
  - Top set at 0–1 RIR; aim for a small rep PR over Week 9 equivalents or a modest load increase while keeping form.
  - Back-offs: Keep load, shorten rest by ~15 sec versus Week 10 or add 1 rep.
- Add 1–2 “overload finishers” in the week (not every day):
  - Drop set: On one delt or arm isolation, strip 20–30% weight and continue to near-failure once.
  - Extended set: On hip thrusts or hack squats, perform a constant-tension final set (no lockout) to 1 RIR.

Week 12 (Peak effort; strategic failure on isolations)
- Compounds: Maintain Week 11 loads; attempt small rep PRs at the same RIR, or the same reps with slightly tighter rest.
- Back-offs: Push to the top of rep ranges at 0–1 RIR; stop at technical failure if form degrades.
- Isolations: One exercise per session may go to true failure with a safe modality (machine or cable). Optionally add a single intensity method:
  - Mechanical drop set on laterals (DB to cables) or biceps (incline curl to hammer curl).
  - Myo-reps on leg extensions or curls.
- Cap total intensity techniques to 1–2 per session to protect recovery.

Session-by-session tweaks (apply in Weeks 10–12)
Push
- Bench or close-grip bench: Top set 4–6 at 1 RIR; back-offs 2x6–8 with -8–10% load.
- DB incline press: Final set rest-pause (20 sec) in Weeks 10 and 12.
- Laterals: Myo-reps (Week 10) and mechanical drop set (Week 12).
- Triceps pressdown or overhead cable: Lengthened partials after failure (3–5 reps).

Pull
- Weighted pull-up/row: Top set 4–6 at 1 RIR; straps allowed to bias back.
- Chest-supported row: Final set rest-pause (Week 10 or 12).
- Rear delts: Reverse pec deck myo-reps (Week 9 or 11).
- Biceps: EZ or incline curls with lengthened partials after full-ROM failure.

Lower (Quads)
- High-bar or front squat: Top set 4–6 at 1 RIR; back-offs 2–3x6–8. No failure.
- Hack squat/leg press: Final set constant tension to 0–1 RIR; optional drop set in Week 12 only.
- Leg extension: Myo-reps or rest-pause; stop if knee discomfort.

Upper (Mixed)
- OHP: Top set 4–6 at 1 RIR; back-offs 2x6–8. Keep reps strict; avoid layback.
- One-arm cable row: Final set rest-pause.
- Curls/pressdowns: Alternate myo-reps and partials across weeks.

Glutes/Hams
- Deadlift/RDL: Top set 3–6 at 1–2 RIR; no failure. Back-offs 2x4–8 controlled.
- Hip thrust: Final set constant tension for max glute burn; optional 1 drop in Week 12.
- Hamstring curl: Rest-pause or myo-reps.

Recovery controls while intensity is higher
- Volume guardrail: If you add intensity, don’t also add lots of extra sets. Keep total weekly sets stable; swap in intensity techniques instead of more volume.
- Soreness/performance check: If performance on compounds drops two sessions in a row, remove intensity techniques first, then add rest.
- Sleep and calories: Maintain surplus; add 20–40 g extra carbs on the two hardest days.
- Cardio: On Weeks 11–12, keep cardio at the lower end of your target (reduce by ~20%) to prioritize lifting.

Safety cues
- Spot big barbell presses. Use safeties on squats; bail plan ready.
- Favor machines/cables for sets to failure.
- Maintain bracing and neutral spine on hinges; no failed deadlift reps.

Outcome targets for Phase 3
- 1–3 rep PRs on top sets across key lifts.
- Back-off volume at or near top rep ranges with tighter rest.
- Visible pump and soreness contained to 24–48 hours; if longer, peel back intensity methods.

This pushes Phase 3 intensity intelligently—heavy top sets, denser back-offs, and strategic failure on isolations—while safeguarding form and recovery.
